single.rationale: Despite impressive 202% revenue growth and emerging gross margin positivity, Amprius faces critical structural challenges: heavy cash burn ($35.5M FCF), persistent operating losses ($46.6M on $73M revenue), massive share dilution (22% YoY), extreme valuation (20x EV/revenue), and a $20M lease termination liability hitting Q1 2026. The reliance on Berzelius without established commercial terms creates significant pricing/supply risk. While the technology shows promise in high-value aerospace applications, the path to profitability remains uncertain with limited cash runway.

dropped.claim: Amprius presents a classic early-stage commercialization case where genuine technological validation meets structural execution risk. The company achieved clear inflection on revenue growth of 202.1% and gross margin turning positive at 11.3%, while operating losses remained flat at -$46.6M, demonstrating emerging operating leverage. However, three material factors warrant caution: (1) the Berzelius supply relationship lacks established commercial pricing despite current workable economics, creating uncertainty as volumes scale; (2) the $20.0M Brighton termination and $19.1M impairment represent meaningful capital destruction and strategic reversal; and (3) continuing cash consumption of -$31.1M and 22.3% dilution indicate ongoing financing needs. The defense customer validation is meaningful, but the path from 11.3% gross margin to operating profitability requires either sustained triple-digit revenue growth or material operating expense leverage not yet demonstrated. This merits continued monitoring to assess whether the next twelve months show operating expense discipline and gross margin expansion toward 20%+ levels, or whether cash consumption and dilution accelerate.
